title: Permit-to-Work Ops Check
source_citation: Facilities SOP pattern for isolating energy sources before maintenance work; generic across HSE permit-to-work frameworks.

steps.title: Isolate the energy source
steps.instruction: Lock out and tag the relevant panel or valve. Photograph the lock in place.

steps.title: Confirm zero energy state
steps.instruction: Test with a calibrated meter and record the reading before anyone touches the equipment.

steps.title: Brief the work crew
steps.instruction: Walk the crew through the scope, hazards, and stop-work authority before work starts.

steps.title: Perform the work
steps.instruction: Complete the maintenance task as scoped. Note any deviation from plan.

steps.title: Restore energy and log completion
steps.instruction: Remove the lockout, restore power, and record who performed the work and when.
